questions.text: Doctor, do you have an opinion, within a reasonable degree of medical probability, whether all of the treatment reflected in the records was reasonable, necessary, and causally related to the work incident?
questions.quote: Plan: left L4-L5 transforaminal epidural steroid injection.
questions.note: This plan identifies treatment to ask about; it does not establish that all treatment was reasonable, necessary and related.

questions.text: And separately, Doctor, as to the bills themselves listed on the bill memo, the charges from Fennimore County Hospital, Brightwater Family Medicine, Ridgeline Physical Therapy, Lakeshore Imaging, Dr. Priya Okonkwo-Lind, do you have an opinion whether those bills are reasonable and causally related to that same work incident?
questions.quote: In my opinion the L4-L5 disc protrusion is causally related to the lifting injury of 03/11/2025 described by the patient, within a reasonable degree of medical probability.
questions.note: The attorney must supply and confirm the bill memo; this record does not establish the bills opinion.
